samples.content: Go to the movie theater now; the preview you wanted starts in 20 minutes.
Do I really need to see the previews?
Yes—it’s a limited trailer only shown before this movie.
Okay, I’ll grab my coat.
Take your ticket confirmation with you.
Got it.
Leave now to find your seat before the lights go down.
Heading out now.
Go to the post office now; they close in 30 minutes.
I thought they were open until 6 PM.
Not today—they’re closing early for maintenance.
Alright, I’ll get my package ready.
Pack it securely and bring your ID for verification.
Got it, I’ll head there immediately.
Leave now to avoid last-minute queues.
I’m out the door.
Go to the main library now; the event starts in 15 minutes.
Right now? I thought it started later.
Leave immediately so you make it on time—it was rescheduled earlier.
Do you know which room it’s in?
Head straight to the Community Hall on the second floor.
Alright, I’ll grab my bag and head out.
Take your library card—they might check it at the entrance.
Got it, I’m on my way now.
Get to the train station immediately; catch the earlier train to avoid rush hour.
But I planned for the 6 PM train.
Change your plan—take the 5:15 and arrive before dark.
How much earlier should I leave to catch that one?
Leave in the next 10 minutes so you have time to buy your ticket calmly.
Alright, but I’ll need to pack quickly.
Pack now and focus on essentials—I’ll list them for you.
Perfect, let’s do that and then I’ll head out.
Head to the farmer’s market now; the best produce will be gone within the hour.
Is it really that busy this early?
Yes, and you missed the peaches last time by arriving late.
Do they still have that fresh bread stall?
Yes—go now before their sourdough sells out.
Okay, I’ll grab my shopping bag and head over.
Bring cash—some stalls don’t take cards.
Thanks, I’ll be there in 15 minutes.
Leave for the airport right now; security lines are extremely long today.
I was going to leave in an hour.
Do not wait—you risk missing your flight if you delay.
What’s causing the delay?
Extra screening is in place for all international flights—factor in more time.
Alright, I’ll get my luggage together now.
Keep your passport and boarding pass ready to speed up check-in.
Got it—I’m leaving now.
Start the hike now; the trail gets crowded by mid-morning.
I was planning to go around noon.
Change your plan—go now to enjoy cooler air and peace on the trail.
Do you think I’ll need a jacket this early?
Yes—pack a light jacket to stay warm.
Okay, I’ll pack that and some snacks.
Bring water—there’s no refill station until halfway.
Alright, I’m ready to head out now.
Drive to the vet now; they can fit your pet in before lunch.
Can’t I schedule for tomorrow?
No—tomorrow is fully booked.
Alright, I’ll get the carrier.
Also, take your pet’s medical records.
Okay.
Go now—you’re on a tight slot.
Leaving now.
Head to the pharmacy now; your prescription will be returned to stock if you don’t pick it up today.
I can get it tomorrow, can’t I?
No—it will be restocked tonight.
Okay, I’ll take my wallet and insurance card.
Bring your prescription slip too.
Got it.
Leave now to make it before closing.
On my way.
Get to the bus stop immediately; your bus arrives in 6 minutes.
I can catch the next one if I miss it.
Don’t risk it—the next bus is in 40 minutes.
Alright, I’ll grab my bag.
Take your umbrella—it might rain.
Okay.
Go now—you don’t have a second to waste.
Running out the door.
Walk to the bakery right now; fresh croissants just came out of the oven.
Will they have enough left?
Only if you go now—people are already lining up.
I’ll take my reusable bag.
Good—bring cash for faster checkout.
Got it.
Hurry before they sell out.
Heading there now.
Drive to the gas station now; prices will go up this afternoon.
Is it a big increase?
Yes—30 cents more per gallon.
Alright, I’ll grab my keys.
Check your tire pressure while you’re there.
Good idea.
Go now to avoid the rush before the price hike.
Leaving now.
Go to the electronics store right away; the sale ends at noon.
Do you think they’ll still have stock?
Yes, but the popular items are selling fast.
Alright, I’ll grab my wallet.
Take your membership card for extra discounts.
Got it.
Leave immediately to beat the crowd.
I’m heading there now.
Leave for the conference hall now; registration closes at 9:45 AM.
Can’t I register online instead?
No—this event requires in-person check-in.
Alright, let me print my ticket.
Print it quickly and take a pen for signing forms.
Done.
Leave now—you’re cutting it close.
I’m on my way.
Head to the gym right now; your class starts in 20 minutes.
I was thinking of skipping today.
Don’t skip—your trainer prepared a session just for you.
Okay, what should I bring?
Grab your water bottle, towel, and resistance bands.
I’ll pack them now.
Good—leave in the next 5 minutes to arrive on time.
Heading out now.
